horoscopes.horoscope: Today, you feel free and liberated! And in that spirit, you want to travel or do things you loved doing as a child. A good time for a family outing, says Ganesha. Keeping in mind your mood, you may even make plans for the future for your near and dear. You will be prepared for romantic connections. If you are already in one, expect it to blossom. You will be confident while being with your sweetheart. You are in a mood to excite your partner and give more space. Ganesha finds a positive day lying ahead of you. Your enthusiasm level will remain high however, you may need to divert your fire to some constructive activity otherwise, anger may spoil your mood and day both. This is a good day to start gym or physical exercise at home. You will be able to find proper resources who can finance you or who can help you with your project. Today you are going to meet right people at right time and and get the right opportunities. Your enthusiasm will help you achieve your routine activities easily in the office today. You may feel bored post lunch. You will be ready to take more challenges in the evening. However, you should not take up complex things. It’s better to take tasks that are easy to be accomplished, says Ganesha.

You must learn to get to the root of a routine to keep things fresh today, feels Ganesha. Just learn the basic psychology of people and analyse the facts. All action and decision has a motive, you will need to understand the chain to get the most out of things, advises Ganesha. You need to think pros and cons before getting into a relationship. A stronger bonding between you and your life partner is possible. Your relationship with your life partner or beloved is ready to flourish. It’s a day to handle relationships carefully, reminds Ganesha. The day is going to be very stressful for you today, feels Ganesha. You may feel tired easily. You may take more time in resolving issues because neither health nor mood will be supporting you. Avoid wasting time in useless activities. You should not get into traps of negative vibrations. Don’t let other people’s view about your financial standing, affect you; as it will deviate you from what you desire to do with your money or life. You may be pushed to work harder at the office today. This, of course, may not bother you as you are practical by nature. You are likely to solve complex projects and make a good decision. Your relations with seniors may require nurturing, feels Ganesha.

You have a certain degree of equanimity when it comes to reacting to praise and criticism. Today, however, you will be emotional, and it won’t be too bad. You will get appreciated at work and your liberal show of emotions will only make others like you more. Your colleagues will say three cheers for you. But avoid an emotional outburst as it may turn cheers into jeers. You are likely to pay attention to your life partner and he/she seems to be pleased with all the attention you give him/her today. You will enjoy a harmonious time with your partner. The day is all about dealing with your partner around you. Ganesha feels that you should use your communication skill to resolve some issues with other people however you should not speak much as it will drain you faster. Try to save your energy by speaking less and even by thinking lesser. You might want to throw a party or you might want to buy expensive costumes to make yourself feel good first so that when you meet others, they are impressed. You might have to deal with people with various attributes today. It’s the time to use your wit when dealing with others at work. You may pour all your energies to explore new avenues. You need to be careful while making important decisions.

Today, Cupid will send its arrow right through your heart. You will be trembling with pain – the sweet pain of lust and love. But the overzealous Cupid may not stop at just that. Just to be completely sure, it will virtually do shooting practice at you. You can do nothing but tell your love interest how badly you have been hit. However, Ganesha suggests that you be as conservative as possible in your approach. Emotion is running deeply in you. Ganesha feels you will get more emotional over small issues in your present relationship. You should not let any complexities reign your mind. You need to stay away from any disagreement. Try to please your lover with something funny and interesting. You should try to remain flexible and adjust with people and situations. Ganesha’s advise to you is to take necessary rest rather than letting yourself get drained. You should avoid doing lot of physical exercise as your energy levels are dropping faster today. You have chance to have some pre-approved loans to your bank account. Ganesha feels that first of all, you need to decide on how much you need, then only should apply for the loans. A few critical situations may come your way at the workplace. You need to handle responsibilities and Ganesha feels that you need to make your own judgement. Your support system looks a little weak today, hence you are advised to be careful at the workplace.

It is good to be impulsive sometimes; but if one were to ask you today, you would be all for a meticulously planned approach to life. So much so that from now on, planning will become almost a part and parcel of your life, predicts Ganesha. So, it is expected that you plan everything to perfection today, although the execution of your plans may be a different story. But you can’t do everything, can you? At least the good thing is that you make a great display of your organisational capabilities, says Ganesha. The sun will shine brightly for you on the relationship front. Therefore, it is a lucky day to propose someone says Ganesha. The ongoing relationship may take a positive turn, by the grace of Ganesha. In short, it’s a comfortable day, more on the positive side. It’s a good day for health. Blood circulation will be faster. Digestive system will be working very well. You should however avoid over-eating. More you have fruits, better it would be for your health. You should make the most out of this ‘healthy day’. Ganesha feels that today, guidelines of some financial advisor will help you a great deal about handling of your money. Alternatively, you yourself will do research on the subject of investing money. Ganesha finds you impulsive and active today. You are confident in your approach and able to complete the tasks with confidence. You may have high expectations from your colleagues. However, with your positive approach you are likely to achieve your objectives, feels Ganesha.

You will start the day by scribbling down things to do. But don’t just jot them down; instead, set realistic goals and prioritise them. Items you mark highest will demand quick actions, cautions Ganesha. Ganesha feels you may have to abide by a fixed schedule to balance personal and professional lives. You will be concerned about requirements of your beloved. Your sympathetic attitude will please your sweetheart. You are in a mood to explore a new destination with your loved one. Today you need to relax your mind as that’s going to be the secret of good health. Do not apply too much logic to things. Just chill and take rest, if you can’t take leave from office or if you can’t call it a day, leave little early. Today, rather than taking ‘action’, you should invest some time behind research activity. You should do proper study of things available in the market and their price. Today, you may realize that it is necessary to work harder to take your career forward from where you are, hence you may try to put in more effort. You may like to bring some new insights. Slowly but steadily you will build your efficiency.

It’s a spiritual and harmonious mood that grips you today, feels Ganesha. You may want to focus on meditation, as you essentially seek peace. This may have something to do with the fact that at work, your subordinates may attempt to throw around their weight to force you to make drastic changes. But do not let it bother you too much. Just ensure that you consider all things at hand before you take any decision. Tackle things with tact, and remember to be calm. Breathe!. A smooth sailing is expected on the relationship front by the grace of Ganesha. You may want to discover the romantic side of your sweetheart. Your sweet and naughty nature will attract your partner. You are likely to seek pleasure in lovemaking. The day may be bit demanding and activities may be rapid but still you will not feel tired. This is a good day to enjoy outing too. Everything that you do today will add to your energy. You will be very receptive today, feels Ganesha. Ganesha feels that because of your balanced approach towards everything, financial matters will remain in your control. It is an ideal day to plan a trip or go on a trip. If you do so, you will derive lot of joy. You will find yourself quite eloquent today. Expect yourself to be at your creative best. Your ideas will earn appreciation from your superiors since these are expected to achieve goals. Being intuitive and spontaneous today will help you handle everything appropriately.

It is more than likely that you will find yourself in a tricky situation today, says Ganesha. You may start the day feeling lonely and empty but yet, at the same time, you will have some responsibility that will prevent your from showing it. Try to keep your mind off negative thoughts. Work and friends will help you cheer up later in the day. Ganesha says you will enjoy your relationship with your loved one. You may be an intense lover, but having unfair expectations from your partner may lead to disappointment. In order to be happy, be realistic in what you seek, suggests Ganesha. Don’t just let fights take out major part of your energy. You should try to remain calm in order to maintain good health and mood. Though the day is not indicating bad health but it looks like a stressful day for sure. If you are a freelancer, you will get good new projects. If you are in business, your marketing will result in good business which will bring in a large amount of money. You should keep important decisions pending today, advises Ganesha. Wait for the right time. At work, you will be in an unusual mood as you won’t be able to do what you want. You need to focus on the easy works before taking up complex projects.

Stay stern, says Ganesha, as it might be necessary to exercise your grit to get the desired results today. Your presence may be dominating at the workplace, but your subordinates will find your manner pleasing as you hold them in awe of you. Do not get carried away by your success or the tables may turn, suggests Ganesha. A cheerful and charming day is on the cards. Romance is likely to be on the peak. You are in a mood to express your love to your dream partner. Your adventurous spirit will take you to the outdoors and you will have a thrilling, chilling, and exciting time. Ganesha foresees that this is going to be ‘busy day’ for you. There will be lot of engaging activities keeping you busy today. As health and energy levels will be good, you will be able to deal with all those things wonderfully. Your original extravagant, spendthrift nature will be very active today. You will have strong desire to buy things. You may not think for longer time if you are tempted to buy something. You may feel quite optimistic today, feels Ganesha. Confidence will be clearly reflected in your behaviour and actions. Due to your positive spirits, you may create a positive aura in the office. You may take up challenging tasks and finish them off in time.

You will prioritise your needs, and the most critical would be the need to manage finances to save for the future. Also, the company you choose to keep will reflect the kind of person you are. So, beware of who you befriend, warns Ganesha. You are likely to re-discover your soul after meeting your sweetheart. You may wish to establish a spiritual union with your mate. You will keep your faith in your partner. In short, the day is more Karmic in terms of relationship matters, says Ganesha. Today your resistance power will be low, says Ganesha You won’t be able to complete your tasks in time which will generate stress. It’s ideal day to do Yoga and meditation but not a good day to do physically or mentally challenging tasks. Ganesha feels that today you are going to spend money like anything. Medication, hospitalization, long distance trips etc. might eat a good chunk of your savings. This is ideal time to invest money. You may focus on loss and gain at the workplace as the broadminded thoughts keep coming and going from your mind, foretells Ganesha. Your ideas, opinions or suggestions lack practical depth and sounds more philosophical and thus mostly may go in vain, feels Ganesha.

Today, you will have a lot of fun with your siblings! Though generally well-organised and methodical, you will enjoy going with the flow of what your siblings and friends plan for you. Sometimes, spontaneity is a good thing, says Ganesha. Cheerful mood of your life partner will influence you too. You will be in a party mood or go for a long drive with that special someone. A road trip is on the cards and you will be confident in your relationship, feels Ganesha. Today you will be in a good health. It’s time to catch up with friends, plan to meet up or just give surprise. Joy that you share will double up. You will be able to find new light in life by meeting new people. Ganesha feels that today you will be thinking about money. Your thinking process will be good and you will be able to go deeper in the subject. However, over-contemplation will not help you much. This will be a profit making day, says Ganesha. You will fetch gains through various means. You will remain decisive and maintain a professional harmony. While addressing a group or discussing various matters, you will manage to stick to the point, feels Ganesha.

There are indications you will be in hot pursuit of leisure today, says Ganesha. This will probably be in the form of a short trip to recharge your batteries, and is probably fuelled by your satisfaction in the realisation that the role you play within your organisation is consequential, satisfying as well as rewarding. Ganesha feels it is a positive day. However, you may have to sort out a few matters related to your relationship. You will succeed in striking a better level of understanding with your partner. This is the time to make a new relationship. Today you will be very focussed on your professional targets. Due to good health and complete focus, the day looks very good. You will be able to work for longer hours if you want or if you ‘have to’ – and that too – without getting tired. Ganesha feels that today you will be very action oriented. You will not run after money but you will run after work and money will follow. This is ideal time to build or rebuild good rapport with your superiors. Ganesha finds you becoming more practical about the work. You may be interested in working on long term plans. You may not take up complex projects and are likely to focus on easy matters. You seem to be more result-oriented and you will maintain effectiveness.
